set system host-name CR.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-2001
set firewall family inet filter acl-2001.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term allow-traffic.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address 10.10.10.0/24.explanation: Configures the source address conditions for access to the control list.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masks in source IP address.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set policy-options policy-statement poli.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term set-next-hop.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

then next-hop 192.168.11.2.explanation: The command `then next-hop [parameter3]` in Junos sets the next-hop IP address for traffic matching a specific routing policy or firewall filter rule.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the next hop.

then accept.explanation: Configure the action of the policy statement as accepted.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 192.168.10.2/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family inet filter input acl-2001.explanation: Configure the input filter for the interface.
